content.text:
Add scoreboard widget with server-held win/loss tally

- New "Scoreboard" widget: overlay shows persistent win/loss count,
  configurable labels/colors/position, pushed to all overlays via hub
  and delivered on connect via SSE.
- Dock gets ± / reset controls; firing WIN/LOSE from dock auto-increments.
- New /api/control/[token]/score endpoint mirrors controlFire's token
  auth + rate limit (factored into shared src/lib/control.ts).
- Confetti/glitch result animations reworked (multi-layer bursts, ash/vignette).
- Migrations add User.wins/losses/scoreConfig columns.
